params.name: QUERY
params.value:
"
MERGE " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + " T
USING (
  SELECT * EXCEPT(rn)
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY InvoiceNumber ORDER BY SystemModifiedAt DESC) AS rn
    FROM " + context.parameter_Env_Prefix + "." + (String)globalMap.get("parameter_table_name_bc") + "Delta
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
) D
ON T.systemId = D.systemId

WHEN MATCHED AND (
  T.SystemModifiedAt IS NULL OR D.SystemModifiedAt > T.SystemModifiedAt OR T.systemId IS DISTINCT FROM D.systemId
) THEN
UPDATE SET
  T.systemId                = D.systemId,
  T.ShippingAgentCode       = D.ShippingAgentCode,
  T.ShipToCode              = D.ShipToCode,
  T.InvoiceDiscountValue    = D.InvoiceDiscountValue,
  T.ShipToName              = D.ShipToName,
  T.Closed                  = D.Closed,
  T.RemainingAmount         = D.RemainingAmount,
  T.InvoiceDiscountAmount   = D.InvoiceDiscountAmount,
  T.Cancelled               = D.Cancelled,
  T.ShipToName2             = D.ShipToName2,
  T.ShipToAddress           = D.ShipToAddress,
  T.ShipToAddress2          = D.ShipToAddress2,
  T.ShipToCity              = D.ShipToCity,
  T.SellToPhoneNumber       = D.SellToPhoneNumber,
  T.SellToEmail             = D.SellToEmail,
  T.VAT_Reporting_Date      = D.VAT_Reporting_Date,
  T.OrderDate               = D.OrderDate,
  T.SellToCustomerNumber    = D.SellToCustomerNumber,
  T.PostingDate             = D.PostingDate,
  T.SystemCreatedAt         = D.SystemCreatedAt,
  T.SystemCreatedBy         = D.SystemCreatedBy,
  T.SystemModifiedAt        = D.SystemModifiedAt,
  T.SystemModifiedBy        = D.SystemModifiedBy,
  T.ShipmentDate            = D.ShipmentDate,
  T.PaymentTermsCode        = D.PaymentTermsCode,
  T.DueDate                 = D.DueDate,
  T.ShipmentMethodCode      = D.ShipmentMethodCode,
  T.CurrencyCode            = D.CurrencyCode,
  T.CurrencyFactor          = D.CurrencyFactor,
  T.BillToCustomerNumber    = D.BillToCustomerNumber,
  T.OrderNumber             = D.OrderNumber,
  T.BillToName              = D.BillToName,
  T.SellToContactNumber     = D.SellToContactNumber,
  T.BilltoContactNumber     = D.BilltoContactNumber,
  T.FiscalDocumentNoFNX     = D.FiscalDocumentNoFNX,
  T.FiscalTrackingIDFNX     = D.FiscalTrackingIDFNX,
  T.FiscalNoFNX             = D.FiscalNoFNX,
  T.BranchCodeFNX           = D.BranchCodeFNX,
  T.SellToTerritoryCodeFNX  = D.SellToTerritoryCodeFNX,
  T.ShipToTerritoryCodeFNX  = D.ShipToTerritoryCodeFNX,
  T.BillToTerritoryCodeFNX  = D.BillToTerritoryCodeFNX,
  T.SellToDistrictFNX       = D.SellToDistrictFNX,
  T.ShipToDistrictFNX       = D.ShipToDistrictFNX,
  T.BillToDistrictFNX       = D.BillToDistrictFNX,
  T.BillToNumberFNX         = D.BillToNumberFNX,
  T.ShipToNumberFNX         = D.ShipToNumberFNX,
  T.SellToNumberFNX         = D.SellToNumberFNX,
  T.BillToName2             = D.BillToName2,
  T.Amount                  = D.Amount,
  T.AmountIncludingVAT      = D.AmountIncludingVAT,
  T.BillToAddress           = D.BillToAddress,
  T.SellToCustomerName      = D.SellToCustomerName,
  T.BillToAddress2          = D.BillToAddress2,
  T.SellToCustomerName2     = D.SellToCustomerName2,
  T.SellToAddress           = D.SellToAddress,
  T.SellToAddress2          = D.SellToAddress2,
  T.SellToCity              = D.SellToCity,
  T.BillToPostCode          = D.BillToPostCode,
  T.BilltoCounty            = D.BilltoCounty,
  T.BillToCountryRegionCode = D.BillToCountryRegionCode,
  T.SellToPostCode          = D.SellToPostCode,
  T.SellToCounty            = D.SellToCounty,
  T.BillToCity              = D.BillToCity,
  T.SellToCountryRegionCode = D.SellToCountryRegionCode,
  T.ShipToPostCode          = D.ShipToPostCode,
  T.ShipToCounty            = D.ShipToCounty,
  T.ShipToCountryRegionCode = D.ShipToCountryRegionCode,
  T.Correction              = D.Correction,
  T.DocumentDate            = D.DocumentDate

WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
INSERT (
  systemId,
  ShippingAgentCode,
  ShipToCode,
  InvoiceDiscountValue,
  ShipToName,
  Closed,
  RemainingAmount,
  InvoiceDiscountAmount,
  Cancelled,
  ShipToName2,
  ShipToAddress,
  ShipToAddress2,
  ShipToCity,
  SellToPhoneNumber,

  ShipmentDate,

  BillToAddress,
  SellToCustomerName,
  BillToAddress2,
  SellToCustomerName2,
  SellToAddress,
  SellToAddress2,
  SellToCity,
  BillToPostCode,
  BilltoCounty,
  BillToCountryRegionCode,
  SellToPostCode,
  SellToCounty,
  BillToCity,
  SellToCountryRegionCode,
  ShipToPostCode,
  ShipToCounty,
  ShipToCountryRegionCode,
  Correction,
  DocumentDate
)
VALUES (
  D.systemId,
  D.ShippingAgentCode,
  D.ShipToCode,

  D.Closed,
  D.RemainingAmount,

  D.BillToName2,
  D.Amount,

  D.SellToAddress,

  D.SellToCity,
  D.BillToPostCode,
  D.BilltoCounty,
  D.BillToCountryRegionCode,
  D.SellToPostCode,
  D.SellToCounty,
  D.BillToCity,
  D.SellToCountryRegionCode,

)
"
